title: Shark Tank India 5: Children Apparel Brand Founder Reacts To Aman Gupta 'Shut Down' Remark | Television News - News18
text: Shark Tank India 5 saw some new and exciting pitches in its first week. While some start-ups and founders have secured significant finance, a handful have had to walk away without a contract. One such creator who did not receive funding on the show was Lucknow’s Ravi Kumar Gupta , who appeared in the tank with his five-year-old daughter to pitch his children’s clothing line, Guugly Wuugly. While the ‘sharks’ were impressed by Ravi’s modesty, when it came to logistics, things didn’t go his way. After the pitch, Ravi went away with advice to close his brand from Aman Gupta and Kunal Bahl, while Mohit Yadav advised him to take a serious look at his firm and avoid involving his ego, citing his own example. Following his Shark Tank India experience, Ravi in an interview with Screen shared how the show affected his business and how he responded to suggestions from Aman, Kunal and others. Ravi Gupta shares his Shark Tank Experience In the conversation, Ravi Kumar Gupta spoke about his Shark Tank India experience and said, “The experience was amazing, every person there from day one has been very helpful. They briefed us in a very nice and detailed manner. As a founder, we experience this for the very first time, so they make us comfortable, help us prepare for the tank. I suppose 99 percent of the founders have never faced a camera in their lives." He also reacted to what occurred during his presentation and mentioned that he believed whatever they said was correct, and it was a suggestion. As they’ve developed such massive businesses, they know how Indian customers are and what a founder should do in the early stages of their startups. He added, “I have implemented a few things from their feedback. Mohit is helping me out as he promised. We spoke recently, and he is giving me all the possible suggestions that can turn around this brand. Everyone has their own thought process, but I need to understand their concerns. Their suggestions have really helped me." Will Ravi Gupta Close His Brand? Talking about Aman’s idea to quit the business, Ravi said he didn’t intend to do so. “Contrary to what Aman said, I am not planning to close this down," said the founder. Ravi Kumar Gupta went on Shark Tank India 5 to seek an investment of Rs 50 lakhs in exchange for 5% interest in his children’s clothing firm. Ravi stated that he planned to launch Guugly Wuugly in November 2022 and that he is now losing money. He also disclosed that he had invested all of his cash, his wife’s jewellery, and even a home loan increase to ensure the brand’s continued success.
